notes.title: A Place, Forbidden Update 20200630
notes.content:
The previous update still had some remaining issues with achievement unlocks and the notebook which came down to conflicts with save data. Thank you to BabblingFishes and The Stranger for sending us reports which got us on the right track for solving the problem.

All Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed save data conflict when doing certain actions in a specific order
[*] Fixed notebook progress sometimes getting reset
[*] Fixed unlocks for the following achievements: "Doomed", "All the Pieces - But to What?", "Keen Eyed"
[*] Fixed some objects displaying placeholder text when inspecting
[*] Fixed FPS drop down resetting to 60 after being set to Unlimited
[*] Fixed player collision with vent in Room 2
[*] Fixed post processing issue that caused shiny materials to flicker and appear too bright
[/list]

Thank you for your patience! If you find any more issues with the game, please let us know in the Bug Reports forum.

notes.title: A Place, Forbidden Update 20200626
notes.content:
As some of you have noticed, achievements didn't properly unlock in the release version of [i]A Place, Forbidden[/i]. This hotfix should solve this and a few additional minor bugs.

All Changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed majority of achievements not unlocking
[*]Changed name and unlock conditions of one achievement
[*]Fixed bug where the keybinding menu could get stuck on the screen
[*]Fixed typos
[*]Adjusted volume of a few sound files
[/list]
